<description>
Make sure we send out all three connections when initiating a private broadcast.

Use `MarkReceived` instead of `Remove` to mark a tx as having been received back. Prevent additional stale retry connections by tracking disconnects and explicitly granting new connections with `TryGrantRetry`.

Intended as an alternative to #34707, addressing the theoretical timing attack described in https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/34707#issuecomment-5603256702. Also fixes theoretical timing attacks described in https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/29415#discussion_r2035693786.
